basic_details.job_title: APS Narangi Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 5 UDC, Pre-Primary Teacher and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Army Public School Narangi has invited applications for APS Narangi Recruitment 2026 to fill 05 vacancies for Pre-Primary Teacher, Librarian, UDC, Accountant, and Paramedics (Nursing Assistant) posts on an adhoc basis. Eligible candidates must submit their hard copy applications with bio-data, resume, photocopies of relevant certificates, and a passport-size photograph, along with a demand draft of Rs 250/- in favour of APS Narangi payable at Guwahati. The last date to submit applications is 31 Oct 2026 till 2:00 pm.

qualification.details: Graduate with 50% marks from a recognized Institution/University. For Fresh Teachers Appt: Diploma of minimum two year duration in Nursery Teacher Education/ Pre-School Education/ Early Childhood Education Programme (D.E.C.Ed) or a B Ed (Nursery) from any NCTE recognized institution. For Teachers in Service: Nursery Teachers Training Course (NTT) or ECCE qualification obtained from IGNOU/NIOS/any other NCTE recognized institution. Age as on 01 Apr 2026: Fresh Candidates - Not less than 25 years & below 40 years. Experienced candidates - Upto 55 years (Minimum 5 years teaching experience in the last 10 years in Pre-Primary Classes). | B Lib. Science or Graduate with Diploma in Library Science from a recognized Institute and computer literate with minimum 3 years' experience. | B. Com. or fifteen years of service as a clerk (for Ex-Servicemen). Computer literate (MS Office, Tally etc.). Computer Savvy (12000 key depression per hour). Knowledge of relevant software applications used by Schools. 5 years' experience as a clerk or an accounts clerk in a reputed organization; preferably a school. Experienced candidates: Below 55 years. | Commerce Graduate or fifteen years' service as a clerk in the Defence Services. Basic computer application course of Army/ Diploma in computer applications of not less than one-year duration. Knowledge of double entry system of accounting, excel sheet and accounting software. Minimum 5 years' experience as an Accountant Clerk in Defence Services/reputed organization. | 10+2 and diploma in nursing with minimum five years of experience. A female Paramedic should be given preference. Minimum 5 years' experience in the appropriate category in the last 10 years.

important_instructions: Only one application form will be filled up for one post. Applications must be sent in the form of a Hard Copy. The application form must be accompanied by a DD of ₹ 250/- payable at Guwahati. Applications must include bio-data/resume, photocopies of all relevant certificates/testimonials, and a passport-size photograph. Submissions must reach by 31 Oct 2026 till 2:00 pm.

content_sections.heading: About APS Narangi
content_sections.text: Army Public School Narangi is located at PO: Satgaon, Guwahati – 781 027, Assam under the Local Screening Board.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates must fill up the application form available at the school website www.apsnarangi.com. Only one application form will be filled up for one post. Applications along with a Demand Draft for ₹ 250/- drawn in favour of APS Narangi payable at Guwahati, bio-data/resume, photocopies of all relevant certificates/testimonials, and one copy of a recent passport size photograph must be sent to the postal address: ARMY PUBLIC SCHOOL NARANGI, PO: SATGAON, GUWAHATI – 781 027, ASSAM The application must reach the designated authority on or before 31 Oct 2026 till 2:00 pm.
